steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Ethnic representation in media has historically marginalised, stereotyped, or excluded people of colour, but recent years have seen significant improvement. | Key Fact: Traditional stereotypes: Black men as criminals or athletes; Asian people as terrorists or 'model minorities'; Latino people as criminals or domestic workers; Middle Eastern people as terrorists. | Key Fact: Underrepresentation: ethnic minorities have been proportionally underrepresented in mainstream media, particularly in lead roles, directing, and writing positions. | Key Fact: Tokenism: including a single ethnic minority character to appear diverse without giving them meaningful development or narrative importance. Token characters are often stereotypical.
